Pedigree of the mouse lines

Source: R/data.R
ratones_pedigree.Rd

The pedigree behind ratones_morpho: all 525 individuals of the experiment, including the ancestors that were never measured. Used to build the additive relationship matrix A for lmm_animal.

Usage

ratones_pedigree

Format

A data frame with 525 rows and 3 columns, in the order expected by animal_design:

id

individual catalogue number;

sire

catalogue number of the sire, NA for a founder or an unknown parent;

dam

catalogue number of the dam, NA for a founder or an unknown parent.

Source

Penna et al. (2017), archived at Dryad under CC0 1.0 (doi:10.5061/dryad.5gr8r ) and distributed by the MIT-licensed companion package https://github.com/diogro/ratones.

Details

The pedigree is complete and consistent, and the animal model will run on it, but it does not make the mice a quantitative-genetic design. Read the weak identification section of ratones_morpho before using it for anything beyond a worked example, and prefer opossum and its genomic relationship matrix opossum_grm when the genetic covariance is the object of inference.

References

Penna, A., Melo, D., Bernardi, S., Oyarzabal, M. I., & Marroig, G. (2017). The evolution of phenotypic integration: How directional selection reshapes covariation in mice. Evolution, 71(10), 2370-2380. doi:10.1111/evo.13304

See also

ratones_morpho, makeA

Examples

data(ratones_pedigree)
dim(ratones_pedigree)
#> [1] 525   3
head(ratones_pedigree)
#>       id sire dam
#> 1 260482   NA  NA
#> 2 260386   NA  NA
#> 3 260460   NA  NA
#> 4 260466   NA  NA
#> 5 260474   NA  NA
#> 6 260396   NA  NA
sum(is.na(ratones_pedigree$sire))  # founders
#> [1] 84
